title: MRMhub
text: MRMhub processes targeted MRM mass spectrometry data — from raw vendor files through peak integration, quality control, normalisation, drift/batch correction, calibration, and quantitative reporting. It consists of two modules that can be used independently:

title: MRMhub
text:
Why MRMhub?

Reproducible. Every step is code — parameter files for INTEGRATOR, R scripts for QUANT.
Modular. Each module replaces or augments existing pipeline components without lock-in.
MRM-specific. Drift correction, batch correction (Broadhurst 2018), ISTD/calibration quantitation, isotope-interference correction, and the QC vocabulary (BQC, TQC, SBLK, …) built into one container object.


 Citation: Teo et al. (2020). MRMhub: Automated Data Processing for Large-Scale Targeted Metabolomics Analysis. Anal. Chem. 92, 13677–13682. doi:10.1021/acs.analchem.0c03060  |  Source: github.com/SLINGhub/MRMhub  |  Example workflows: mrmhub-workflows ↗
